description: Test fixture for issue #337 round three: an operator-authored dataset whose interaction severity is a spelling this module does not recognise. DrugSafetyValidator.severityRank answers -1 for it, which is the same answer it gives an UNRATED rule, so the whole module already treats such a rating as unrated — clearsSeverityFloor exempts it, licensesWithholding withholds on it. The rating a consumer is handed must agree: there is no word here an answer owes back, whatever the file says. The note restates the word deliberately, so that the record-states-it condition is live and this case turns on statableRating alone.

interactions.note: Serious. Coadministration may increase the risk of bleeding.
